exercises.title: 7. Czarnikow context: fill in the blanks

items.prompt: Scotland, a nation with a ___ of its own, reads a London campaign very differently.
Scots law, a ___ separate from England's, changes how our contracts are drafted in Edinburgh.
items.hintAfterError: São duas palavras: um adjetivo ligado a leis + a palavra para 'tradição'.

items.prompt: Glasgow, a city with its own ___ of business, will not be rushed by a London deadline.
The North, a region known for its ___, prefers plain talk to polished slides.
Harry's task, a delicate one, was ___ the campaign so that it felt local in Leeds.
items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'was' aqui entra o infinitivo com 'to'.

items.prompt: A slogan that sounds witty in London may not ___ in Manchester.
items.hintAfterError: É uma expressão de duas palavras: o verbo 'aterrissar' + um advérbio que significa 'bem'.

items.prompt: Harry, a manager with an ear for ___, noticed that the joke would sound arrogant in Glasgow.
The flag on the poster, a ___ touch rather than a real message, will not win Scottish clients.
The executive, a Londoner by ___, assumed the capital's view was the national view.
Seen ___, a national plan written in London can look like a lecture.
